findings.title: Static Radar Graphic
findings.where: Arena and Road screens, bottom left panel
findings.problem: The radar display is a flat dark circle with a single center triangle, lacking range rings, sweep lines, or any grid markers.
findings.why: It reads as an unfinished placeholder rather than an active instrument, giving the player no frame of reference for scale or scanning.
findings.fix: Add faint, concentric distance rings and a translucent sweeping radar wedge to establish it as an active UI display.

findings.title: Low-Contrast Navigation Bar
findings.problem: The journey progress indicator is a 1-pixel thin white line sitting on a dark, thin track, lacking an opaque container against the busy background.
findings.why: The extreme lack of visual weight and contrast makes it impossible to track progress peripherally while focusing on driving.
findings.fix: Increase the vertical thickness of the progress bar track, place it inside an opaque UI panel, and use a bright accent color (like the title's teal) for the fill.

findings.title: Floating POI Chevrons
findings.problem: The brightly colored navigation chevrons are flat, 2D vectors layered directly over gritty 3D structures without any grounding visual elements.
findings.why: They appear completely disconnected from the world space (like graphical glitches), making it difficult to judge exactly which physical building they are anchored to.
findings.fix: Add a dark, soft drop-shadow on the ground directly beneath each chevron and a faint vertical tether line connecting the icon down to its specific target.

findings.title: Disconnected Stat Alignment
findings.where: Constructor screen, top right stats panel
findings.problem: The labels (COST, WEIGHT, etc.) are far left-aligned while their values are far right-aligned, creating a massive gap of empty dark space between them.
findings.why: This extreme separation breaks the Law of Proximity, forcing the player's eye to physically track across a void, which slows down readability and risks reading the wrong row.
findings.fix: Move the values much closer to their labels using a tighter column layout, or visually bridge the gap with a dotted leader line.

findings.title: Unreadable Speedometer Dial
findings.where: Arena and Road screens, bottom center panel
findings.problem: The radial dial graphic above the speed text consists only of dark grey tick marks on a dark blue background, with no needle or active fill.
findings.why: It provides zero visual feedback of acceleration at a glance, forcing the player to read the small text digits instead of relying on peripheral gauge movement.
findings.fix: Add a brightly colored needle or an illuminated radial fill bar (like a tachometer) that dynamically sweeps across the ticks as speed changes.
